stem.text: Carvone is found in spearmint oil.

stem.label: carvone
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of carvone: a cyclohexenone ring with C=O at the top, a C=C in the ring bearing a methyl group on the right, and an isopropenyl group on the left carbon.

stem.text: Which product is formed when carvone is reacted with $\text{NaBH}_4$?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexene ring with an OH group on one carbon, a C=C in the ring, a methyl group on the right, and an isopropenyl group (CH2=C(CH3)-) on the left.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexanone ring with C=O at the top, a methyl group on the right, and an isopropyl group on the left; no C=C in the ring.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexenone ring with C=O at the top, a C=C in the ring at the lower right, a methyl group on the right, and an isopropyl group on the left.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexanol ring with an OH group at the top, no C=C in the ring, a methyl group on the right, and an isopropyl group on the left.
